mapper.sql: select c.coupon_id,c.template_id,c.buyer_id,c.member_id,c.face_value,c.threshold_amount, c.expire_at,c.used_order_id,c.used_at,c.issued_by,c.create_time, t.name template_name,b.buyer_name,m.phone member_phone,o.order_no,o.status order_status, case when c.status='UNUSED' and c.expire_at<=sysdate() then 'EXPIRED' else c.status end status from gas_coupon c join gas_coupon_template t on c.template_id=t.template_id join gas_buyer b on c.buyer_id=b.buyer_id join gas_member m on c.member_id=m.member_id left join gas_order o on c.used_order_id=o.order_id

if.test: status != null and status != '' and status != 'EXPIRED'

mapper.select:
where c.member_id=#{memberId}
order by c.coupon_id desc
select coupon_id,template_id,buyer_id,member_id,face_value,threshold_amount,status,expire_at, used_order_id,used_at,issued_by,create_time from gas_coupon where coupon_id=#{couponId} for update
mapper.update: update gas_coupon set status='USED',used_order_id=#{orderId},used_at=sysdate() where coupon_id=#{couponId} and status='UNUSED' and expire_at>sysdate() and used_order_id is null

update gas_coupon set status=case when expire_at>sysdate() then 'UNUSED' else 'EXPIRED' end, used_order_id=case when expire_at>sysdate() then null else used_order_id end, used_at=case when expire_at>sysdate() then null else used_at end where coupon_id=#{couponId} and used_order_id=#{orderId} and status='USED'
update gas_coupon set status='EXPIRED' where status='UNUSED' and expire_at<=sysdate()
